custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have a part, part A, active at the test location and inactive at location B under the same part number, so the only other location that stocks it has it inactive.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839439-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839439-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens with no message under Description.

Step 4:

  • The cursor is at the end of the description.

Step 5:

  • Under Description the window shows "This also changes the description at 1 other location.": location B counts although part A is inactive there.

Step 6:

  • The description reads as saved again and the message goes away.

Step 7:

  • No message shows: spaces after the text are not a change.

Step 8:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R12: “When the user changes the description and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the description at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the description at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R13: “That message shows only while the typed description differs from the saved one, ignoring spaces before and after it. Parts at other locations count whether they are active or inactive.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the description at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 9 Oct 2026, answer 5: “A) Yes, count inactive parts too, same as part numbers. Added to S13-R13.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "7.2 An entry opens its detail page", "2.2 Both fields edited". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • library-02-p7-2-entry-detail.png
  • correct-02-p2-2-warnings.png

The design's own words:

  • “Description becomes "Fuel Filter, Mack/Volvo" and Part Number becomes FF5507A. Lethbridge stocks the same Part Library entry, so each field says so under it: "This also changes the description at 1 other location." (S13-R12) and "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." (S13-R16). Each message shows only while the value differs from the saved one (S13-R17).”
